name: Derived formula tier percentages by support level (7-tier completeness)
what_it_tests: Each Maintenance Type Defn AttributeValue maps to its correct derived percent (Expert .35, Premier .30, Express .30, Premium .24, Standard .20, Professional .20, Basic .15, else 0); products with no MTD must not silently fall to a $0 trailing branch (1,708 of 1,887 historically did)
proc_mechanism: DerivedPricingFormula nested IF on AttributeValue x Source_List_Price__c (V16+ 7-tier); unknown/platinum/missing -> 0
expected_behavior: Correct tier percent per AttributeValue; missing MTD -> documented standard, not silent $0; formula must cover all 8 Maintenance_Rate__mdt tiers
test_setup: New derived maintenance lines, one per AttributeValue tier (incl. Expert -> 0.35 x list; missing-MTD case)
